scope: Resolve the G03 experiment-readiness circularity and implement the G06 containment foundation entirely offline. Split baseline comparison into G03a frozen-protocol readiness and G03b later bounded qualification outcome without authorizing provider use; add one disabled-by-default configuration-driven read-only tool facade over an already-built retrieval index, one trusted finding subject, and one stored in-memory architecture map; qualify its typed allowlist, immutable snapshot and index binding, deterministic output, per-call provenance, fail-closed limits, and negative security boundaries; persist one protocol, one aggregate qualification artifact, and one descriptive result; and stop.

G03a.name: baseline-comparison-protocol-readiness
pass_evidence: one immutable protocol fixes identical paired subjects and inputs for the current bounded falsifier and proposed agent
the protocol fixes unique-issue identity, precision, recall, abstention coverage, latency, provider tokens, total cost, and cost per uniquely validated issue before any qualification outcome
the protocol keeps outcomes blinded until both arms have terminal predictions and usage
the protocol defines missing usage, incomplete arms, verifier abstention, and cohort or subgroup insufficiency as fail-closed blockers

G03b.name: bounded-qualification-outcome
G03b.rule: G03b can be evaluated only by a later specially authorized provider-backed qualification after G01, G02, G03a, the offline invariant portion of G04, G05, G06, and G07 pass. G03b and empirical recall safety must pass before any production activation.

g03_decomposition_contract.policy_boundary: This decomposition removes a logical cycle but grants no provider, agent, experiment, threshold, or production authority.

required_enforcement: reject tools absent from the exact allowlist
reject snapshot-commit or retrieval-index-digest drift before returning evidence
accept only canonical index-relative paths already known to the retrieval index
reject absolute paths, parent traversal, NUL bytes, symlink escape attempts, empty or oversized queries, invalid line ranges, and exhausted call budgets
truncate only at explicit structural result boundaries and reject any response still exceeding the byte ceiling
return deterministic JSON-safe evidence plus tool, ordinal, snapshot commit, index digest, request digest, response digest, and boundedness metadata for every successful call
expose no filesystem object, database connection, network client, subprocess interface, repository mutation primitive, or arbitrary callable
qualification: deterministic positive tests for all five allowed tools over synthetic ephemeral fixture source only

negative tests for disabled access, unknown tools, traversal, absolute paths, NUL bytes, symlink escape, snapshot drift, index drift, oversized queries, invalid ranges, result limits, response-byte limits, and call-budget exhaustion
monkeypatched sentinels proving no subprocess, socket, URL opener, store connection, or write primitive is reached
repeatability test proving byte-identical responses and provenance for identical frozen sessions
g06_implementation_contract.integration_boundary: The facade is not wired into challenger.py, the CLI, any provider client, or any production pipeline by this work.

deterministic_sequence: Verify every frozen input digest and the unchanged OPT-010 open lifecycle state.
Freeze the G03a/G03b comparison protocol and reconcile only the agentic escalation gate document.

Add a disabled-by-default validated configuration section and the isolated read-only facade without editing the current challenger, retrieval, slicing, claims, map, CLI, provider, store, or migration implementations.
Run focused positive, negative, repeatability, configuration, retrieval, slicing, claims, prompt-security, and non-live regression tests with network and mutation sentinels.
Persist one aggregate qualification artifact and one descriptive result, hash the production store again, and stop.
Report G03a and G06 as pass only if every frozen contract and negative test passes; otherwise retain partial or documented-fail status without workaround.
